Name: Pelican Town Clothing Bin
Author: Smashley41
Description:
[b][u][size=6]Pelican Town Clothing Bin[/size][/u][/b]

This mod adds a free clothing bin to the right of the Community Center, in front of the fenced garden and seating area. The bin functions like a shop, although everything is free.

[b]What clothes are available?[/b]
The Pelican Town Community Clothing Bin provides all pants and shirt items that are available at the character creation screen, and is intended for farmers who don't like having only one set of clothes for the first few seasons of the game, or farmer's who want to keep up with their fellow villagers when using seasonal outfit mods, or players who just believe the farmer should have more sets of clothing than they start out with.

Any clothing item that is not available during character creation will still need to be obtained through normal gameplay. Accessories are likewise not included because they do not exist as items within the game.

[b]What about coloured items?[/b]
I have been unable to spawn coloured pants/shorts/dresses/skirts into the shop, so my workaround for this has been to add (optional) Rainbow Shells to the bin, which can be used to dye clothing any colour at a Sewing Machine. Unfortunately, this provides you with an early source of Rainbow Shells for profit-making, bundle-contributing and quest-completing, which is against the spirit of the mod. For those of you who need to keep your balance-breaking impulses in check, I have included additional config options to restrict their availability and add prices!

If anyone knows how to make coloured items spawn in shops and wants to tell me how, I will be very grateful and will update the mod!

[b]How about compatibility with map patches, recolours etc.?[/b]
I am not an artist. The Clothing Bin provided is a repurposed recycling bin from the Railway. I think it looks OK. I have provided desaturated options that hopefully blend in better with muted recolours like Earthy and VPR (personally, I think the vanilla version actually looked OK with both of those recolours during testing).

If you encounter a map compatibility issue with other mods, please let me know and I'll look into making compatibility patches.

[b]Permission to make your own retextures/recolours...[/b]
If anyone wants to make replacement art or retextures or recolours of the Clothing Bin, you have my blessing. It occupies a 2x2 tile (32x32 pixel space). If doing so, please upload only your replacement files and list this mod as a requirement.


[b]INSTALLATION[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] are installed
[*]Unzip the mod file to your Stardew Valley Mods folder
[*]Load your game and edit the available options through GMCM
[/list]
[b]TRANSLATIONS[/b]
An i18n file is included. You are welcome to create your own translations under the following conditions...
[list]
[*]You translate the file yourself, without using AI
[*]You upload ONLY the i18n file and NOT the full mod
[*]You list this mod as a requirement
[/list]
If you create a translation please let me know, I will add a link to it on this page with credit to its creator.

[b]OTHER NOTES[/b]
[list]
[*]Other than possible map patch issues with other mods, this mod should be compatible with everything, and is safe to add/remove from your save game at any time. There is a config option to disable the mod, if you feel it has outlived its usefulness in your current playthrough but don't want to uninstall the mod completely.
[*]I suppose if you have other mods that add sell prices to clothing, I have just provided you with an infinite money glitch. The honour system compels you to not take advantage of this ;)
[/list]
